features.description: Go builtin _yaml_to_json (string -> Result[string,string]) in internal/builtins/yaml.go via yaml.Unmarshal->json.Marshal, pattern from json_decode.go. No silent coercion: any marshal error returns Err. Full Go unit tests in yaml_test.go.
acceptance_criteria: ailang builtins list shows _yaml_to_json as [pure] std/yaml
Non-string map key / NaN inputs return Err, never a coerced value
go test ./internal/builtins/ -run YAML green (happy path, nested, sequences, all scalar types, empty->null, flow==block, malformed->Err)
make lint clean on new file
features.notes: internal/builtins/yaml.go (_yaml_to_json, pure, string->Result[string,string]); 15 test funcs in yaml_test.go incl determinism (-count) + non-string-key/NaN/Inf/malformed Err cases. Registered as [pure] std/yaml. builtins pkg builds to wasm.

features.description: std/yaml.ail wrapper: import std/json (Json, decode as jsonDecode); export yamlToJson(s) -> Result[string,string] and decode(s) -> Result[Json,string] composed as match yamlToJson(s){Ok(j)=>jsonDecode(j),Err(e)=>Err(e)}. Reuses std/json Json ADT. Integration test in tests/yaml_bridge_test.ail. NO embed/resolver edits (go:embed *.ail auto-includes it).
acceptance_criteria: ailang docs std/yaml lists yamlToJson and decode with signatures
ailang check std/yaml.ail clean (resolve decode name collision via import alias)
.ail integration test passes: decode round-trip and yamlToJson->json.decode equals equivalent-JSON decode
decode returns the same Json ADT as std/json (constructor identity confirmed in test)
features.notes: std/yaml.ail exports yamlToJson + decode (decode as jsonDecode alias to avoid collision). tests/yaml_bridge_test.ail: 7/7 pass. decode reuses std/json Json ADT (canonical std/ import; stdlib/std/ prefix does not resolve new modules).

features.description: examples/yaml_config.ail (self-contained YAML string, decode + std/json accessors, passes make verify-examples); docs/docs/reference/stdlib/yaml.md; std/yaml row in docs/docs/reference/stdlib.md index; CHANGELOG v0.30.0 entry; GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build ./... verify.
acceptance_criteria: ailang run examples/yaml_config.ail prints expected output; make verify-examples green
features.notes: examples/runnable/yaml_config.ail (runs, prints title/year); manifest entry + coverage recalced, validate_manifest --ci green. docs/docs/reference/std-yaml.md + stdlib.md index row. CHANGELOG entry. WASM verified on ./cmd/wasm + ./internal/builtins (./... fails on pre-existing _unix Setpgid pkgs, not in wasm binary).
